status: FROZEN BEFORE THE IMAGE IS RETRIEVED OR RUN
question: Which board-file format does KiCad 10.0.8 write, and can the PR #933 bounded admission rule accept its single-rectangle Edge.Cuts outline exactly while never admitting unsupported geometry?

tool.verification: the index and the amd64 manifest must hash to these digests and every config and layer blob to its own digest before unpacking; otherwise the proof is BLOCKED

reuse.readers_and_rules: scripts/pcb_outline_planar_clearance_proof.py (PR #933): S-expression reader, F1 topology rule, own DXF group-code reader, ezdxf reading, F3 export freshness
reuse.sandbox: scripts/mp01_sandbox/inner.sh, prepare.sh pattern and unpack.py (PR #934): host uid 65534 with no host capabilities and no_new_privs, unprivileged user/mount/pid/net/ipc/uts namespaces, prlimit limits, read-only image root after pivot_root, no network, cleared environment; inner.sh is reused unchanged, its read-only mount carries the proof inputs

admission_rule.format_version: accepted only if it is the exact (version ...) value KiCad 10.0.8 is observed to write for the fixtures; every other version is refused
admission_rule.geometry: exactly one Edge.Cuts outline: one gr_rect, or exactly four gr_line forming four distinct proper sides of one closed axis-aligned rectangle (the #933 F1 rule); no Edge.Cuts graphics inside a footprint

child_field_allowlist.rule: any other child field on an Edge.Cuts shape, including angle, rotation or any transform, refuses and its name is recorded; a bare atom child is recorded and refuses unless it is in the allowlist

admission_rule.value_of_record: the exact decimals of the board file text, only when the three readings agree
admission_rule.tolerance_mm: 1e-9 (this proof's measurement tolerance, not a method tolerance)

readings: R1: the board file text through the bounded admission rule
R2: KiCad 10's own Edge.Cuts DXF export in mm through the #933 group-code reader
R3: the same export through ezdxf 1.4.2

fixtures.upgraded: each PR #933 KiCad 7 fixture loaded and saved by KiCad 10.0.8 pcbnew
fixtures.native: the same geometries generated natively by KiCad 10.0.8 pcbnew Python: 84 x 50 rectangle, the same rectangle as four lines, revised 80 x 50, and the controls it can express
fixtures.text_controls: a KiCad 10 supported board edited to add an angle field to a gr_line, an unknown geometry field on a gr_rect, and a different (version ...) value; each must refuse
fixtures.envelope: KiCad 10 boards with 0, 5, 20, 40 and 100 synthetic footprints

gates.G1_supported: every supported fixture: R1, R2 and R3 agree within the tolerance on exactly 84 x 50 (or 80 x 50 for the revised board), and the format version is recorded
gates.G2_controls: no control (rounded corners, L shape, cut-out, two boards, open outline, no outline, rotated rectangle, doubled lines, inch export, angle field, unknown field, other version, unfamiliar structure) is ADMITTED by R1; what each reader observed is recorded; KiCad may legitimately export unsupported geometry and that is not a failure
gates.G3_freshness: an export counts only when kicad-cli exits 0 and writes a new file at a path cleared beforehand; the file's SHA-256 binds what is read
gates.G4_geometry_determinism: re-exporting a supported fixture gives the same geometry within the tolerance

observations_not_gates.O1_byte_determinism: raw DXF bytes of repeated exports are compared; harmless metadata differences are classified as such; unexplained differences are investigated and reported
observations_not_gates.O2_envelope: file sizes against the unchanged 128 KiB request cap, and reader tokens, depth and time

outcome.PASS: G1 to G4 hold and the format version is recorded
outcome.PARTIAL: KiCad 10 writes constructs the rule does not recognise for a supported geometry: recorded and refused, never approximated
outcome.BLOCKED: the image cannot be retrieved, verified or run safely, or the readings disagree; recorded, no tool or version substituted

scope: qualifies only the exact observed KiCad 10.0.8 output format and the constructs observed in these fixtures; nothing about other KiCad 10.x releases, other versions or arbitrary PCB files
boundaries: synthetic only; no product change, upload route, reader admission, provider call, merge or deployment; the 128 KiB cap is not changed; BOARD-OUTLINE-SOURCE-BINDING-01 stays BLOCKED
